create_depth_3d_boxes: create DepthInstance3DBoxes from a tensor of 3D bounding box coordinates in depth space
compute_gravity_center: compute the gravity center of each 3D bounding box in the DepthInstance3DBoxes tensor
get_box_corners: get the 8 corner coordinates of each 3D bounding box in clockwise order
rotate_boxes: rotate 3D bounding boxes by a given angle around the z axis with optional points
flip_boxes_bev: flip 3D bounding boxes horizontally or vertically in the bird eye view plane
